verdicts.question: was value created beyond the emission formula by the window's coinbase?
verdicts.scope: the formula coinbase of the 82,477 window blocks 7,415,466..7,497,942 and its payout: each block has one COINBASE miner tx with no value field, exactly one Final miniblock, a payout equal to base + fees, and base rewards summing to CalcSupply(7,497,943) - CalcSupply(7,415,466). Says nothing about hidden (encrypted) amounts, the fee deductions inside them, or burns/SC payouts of the 1,575 blocks whose bodies are pending
